'''Gem Sirrom''' was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], fair-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="DB" /> who represented the world [[Dahvil]]<ref name="SWSF">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Mar 6, 2014}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ROTS Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Sirrom attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], which took place in<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]]<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]],<ref name="CSWE Theed">{{CSWECite|III|235|Theed}}</ref> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], Sirrom wore a red [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and walked in the [[Funeral/Legends|procession]] behind Amidala's coffin.<ref name="ROTS" /> At some point, Sirrom had a son named [[Jake Sirrom|Jake]].<ref name="SWI 148" /> After the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the Galactic Senate's successor, in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Gem took Jake<ref name="SWI 148" /> to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to start a new life. Jake later became a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]],<ref name="SWI 148" /> the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on Bespin.<ref name="DB Wing Guard">{{DB|organization|bespinwingguard|Wing Guard}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gem Sirrom first appeared in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year" /> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="Making Of">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> A [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] patron played by [[Jill Brooks]]<ref name="HSPotCE">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20041124.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Part of the Coruscant Elite}}</ref> could be seen wearing the same outfit earlier in the film.<ref name="ROTS" /> The character at the funeral was identified as "Gem Sirrom" by the Japanese release of ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]],<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> released on [[October 27]], 2005.<ref name="SWCTP date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20050817.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels''}}</ref>
